item.title: Rex's Dino Store: Visit the subway newsstand that's a real fossil
item.description: Welcome to Rex's Dino Store, a public art exhibit that's part of the MTA's Vacant Unit Activation program.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV meets with Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado in a surprise audience
item.description: Pope Leo XIV met with Venezuelan opposition leader and Nobel Peace Prize winner María Corina Machado in a private audience at the Vatican on Monday.

item.title: Minnesota, Minneapolis, Saint Paul file lawsuit to stop ICE's 'federal invasion'
item.description: The suit claims the surge amounts to a "federal invasion" to conduct unconstitutional stops and arrests at sensitive locations.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Beach Hazards Statement through evening, chilly inland overnight
item.description: Our string of cold mornings continued today, as overnight lows again dropped into the low to mid 30s. Tonight will be much like the last few nights, bringing another chill to the inland valleys of the North Bay and East Bay.

item.title: Shoppers on alert after Valley Fair Macy's smash-and-grab, 2nd major crime at mall in recent weeks
item.description: Right in the middle of a busy shopping day, three men with ski masks and hammers entered Macy's. They smashed cases in an attempt to steal expensive watches and stole the sense of security for shoppers as well.

item.title: Oakley neighborhood no longer on lockdown after hourslong standoff, authorities say
item.description: An Oakley neighborhood is no longer on lockdown on Monday after a search for a suspect who shot at a deputy ended, according to the Contra Costa County Sheriff's Office.

item.title: 5 dogs left abandoned in Fremont to be up for adoption soon
item.description: All the dogs are thought to be about three or four years old and Shih Tzu or Poodle mixes. Some of the dogs will be up for adoption starting Wednesday.

item.title: California school district caught up in a dispute over transgender athlete policies
item.description: A Lake Tahoe school district is caught between California and Nevada's competing policies on transgender student athletes.

item.title: You now need an income of $524,000 to buy a home in picturesque San Mateo County, report says
item.description: The picturesque Peninsula is home to several beautiful suburban towns. But for many, being able to live in those towns is increasingly out of reach.

item.title: J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference 2026 kicks off in SF, packing hotels and bringing big business
item.description: As many as 9,500 are in San Francisco for the 44th annual J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference. It is considered to be the "Super Bowl" of the biotech industry.
